title: The Evidence Room
story: A messy archive (`~/archive/`) holds ~300 decoy files across nested folders, a decoy trap directory (`~/archive/decoy_trap`), a scoreboard (`~/archive/scores.txt`), and a single genuine `.evd` evidence file containing `EVIDENCE_MARKER_CYBERUS`.
description:
1. Locate the one `.evd` file inside `~/archive/` that contains `EVIDENCE_MARKER_CYBERUS` and place it at `~/evidence/case.txt`.
2. Delete the `~/archive/decoy_trap` directory completely.
3. Find the researcher handle with the highest numeric score in `~/archive/scores.txt` and write that handle into `~/evidence/top.txt`.
4. Run `quest check` to claim your flag.
hints: Search by filename extension and search inside files for the marker text to pinpoint the real `.evd` file.
Create `~/evidence`, copy or move the matching file to `~/evidence/case.txt`, and remove `~/archive/decoy_trap` recursively.
Sort `~/archive/scores.txt` numerically so the highest score appears at the bottom, write that handle into `~/evidence/top.txt`, and run `quest check`.
